core_finding: Across the three completed CUC runs, posting volume declines after the early event period; chronological and interest recover at the end while random remains lower.
evidence_source: data/weekly_metrics.csv, version=new, posted_all; cross-check agent_supply and sum(posted_{five author types})
analysis_scope: 100 Agents, 2026-W12 through W22, random/chronological/interest each once; no old-model arms or seed averaging
figure_archetype: three overlaid weekly count lines with point markers
audience: user comparing the three just-completed runs
highlight: event-week peak and late recovery; no smoothing
axes_grouping: x=simulation week; y=successful Agent posts/week, zero baseline and common scale
legend_strategy: shared English-only legend with regime and total; colors retained from earlier comparison
reviewer_check: Agent posts exclude external injected material. At most one post per Agent-week means weekly posts equal weekly speakers in these runs. Each new regime has one run only, so no error bars or statistical claims.
